This ensures deterministic behavior for each particle instance [S1, unofficial].

The evidence explicitly states that particle attributes are defined as uniform distributions sampled by a Random Number Generator (RNG) initialized with the particle ID. Because the RNG is seeded deterministically by the particle ID, the same particle ID will always produce the same sequence of random values for attributes like position, speed, and color. This ensures that the behavior of each particle instance is deterministic, as it relies on reproducible mathematical calculations (uniformly accelerated motion) and deterministic sampling rather than stored mutable state or non-deterministic runtime generation.
